clips.prompt: A traveller in a long cloak stands still on a grassy hill holding a tall walking staff upright in the right hand, breathing calmly, shifting weight gently and looking slowly to the left and to the right.
A traveller walks forward in a straight line at a steady unhurried pace, holding a tall walking staff in the right hand and planting it with each step, the left arm swinging naturally.
A person standing still bends the knees and makes one small light hop forward with both feet together, then lands softly with bent knees and stands up straight.
A person standing still raises a tall staff held in the right hand high above the head in a joyful salute, holds it up for a moment while looking up, then slowly lowers it back down to the side.
